traits.name: Weak Bladder
traits.description: A bladder that fills faster than normal. Bathroom needs build more quickly, even though bladder capacity and ordinary control remain unchanged.

traits.name: Incontinence
traits.description: A bladder that is harder to control. Urgency can lead to accidents, and control may occasionally fail even when the Sim is asleep.

traits.name: Small Bladder
traits.description: A smaller effective bladder capacity makes drinks contribute more to bladder urgency. Natural bladder decay and ordinary control remain normal.

traits.name: Bladder Distracted
traits.description: When busy with other activities, this Sim may put off a bathroom trip. The urge continues to build while they stay occupied.

traits.name: Strong Bladder
traits.description: A resilient bladder that fills more slowly and tolerates urgency better. Bathroom needs still occur, but they take longer to become pressing.

traits.name: Large Bladder
traits.description: A larger effective bladder capacity means the same amount of fluid creates a smaller share of bladder urgency.
